train_meta_cfr_agent: train a MetaCFRRegretAgent with specified game name, config, perturbation, and seed for meta learning
compute_next_policy: compute the next CFR policy using a neural network model and regret-based inputs for each infostate
compute_next_policy_invariants: compute one-hot encodings of infostates and illegal action masks for policy computation
cfr_br_meta_data: collect counterfactual values for both players and best response values over multiple CFR epochs
optimize_infoset: apply gradient updates to the meta learner optimizer using counterfactual values for an infoset
